record.provider: Civitai — model version files (the 'arbitrary 65 GiB blob' hub)

free_tier.stated: No published per-account or per-file byte quota. Its own Data Storage Policy states: 'By default, uploaded content will be stored indefinitely with the exception of input and output files related to model training.' Empirically: a single file of 65.83 GiB exists in production, and single free accounts hold 453 GiB (Lykon, 212 models) and 97 GiB (NanashiAnon, 412 models).

retention.stated: No published per-account or per-file byte quota. Its own Data Storage Policy states: 'By default, uploaded content will be stored indefinitely with the exception of input and output files related to model training.' Empirically: a single file of 65.83 GiB exists in production, and single free accounts hold 453 GiB (Lykon, 212 models) and 97 GiB (NanashiAnon, 412 models)

egress.terms: Unmetered; downloads 307-redirect to civitai-delivery-worker-prod...r2.cloudflarestorage.com with a 24 h X-Amz-Expires, then serve 206 with Accept-Ranges: bytes. No per-GB egress charge exists on any Civitai page.

record.tooling: Public REST API v1 (no auth for reads/metadata): /api/v1/models, /api/v1/model-versions/{id}, /api/v1/model-versions/by-hash/{sha256}. Download via GET /api/download/models/{versionId}. Working clients: civitai/cli (official, `civitai download` needs a token), RtypeStudios/CivitAI-Model-Archiver. No rclone backend.
record.chaining: Free accounts carry no stated limit and each holds the same allowance. Models per account and versions per model are unlimited, with a per-file ceiling >=65.8 GiB. 30 TiB = ~460 files at the observed 65.8 GiB ceiling, i.e. one account pushing ~460 'models'. Verified excess-use precedent already on the platform: model 1219185 is literally titled 'hunyuanvideo-lora-training-wsl-ubuntu-system-backup' and is a 65.83 GiB zip of a WSL Ubuntu install uploaded as type 'Other'.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: >=65.83 GiB observed, no published number. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT IS NOT SIZE. It is a per-object access flag plus NSFW gating: creators may set 'require login to download', and such files return HTTP 401 with body {"error":"Unauthorized","message":"The creator of this asset requires you to be logged in to download it"} on BOTH ranged and full GETs (verified consistent. No ranged-lies-while-full-gates behaviour, unlike some round-1 hosts). Of 20 large models sampled, 12 were anonymous-206 and 8 were 401. Training-data retention is a separate, much shorter clause: inputs and training outputs are 30 days. Published per-account storage: Vault is paid-only (Bronze 100 GB / Silver 250 GB / Gold 500 GB) and is a separate product from model hosting.
record.reliability_note: Downloads are reliable and hash-exact when ungated: a full 13,649,928-byte fetch matched the API-advertised SHA-256 exactly (8184D4BA..). Rate: sustained 20 ranged GETs with no 429. The trap is silent partial bodies. A curl without -f writes the 106-byte JSON 401 body to disk as if it were your file, so every download must be hash-checked.

evidence.proved: probe: GET civitai.com/api/v1/model-versions/2752735 -> file 46,149,344,974 bytes (43.0 GiB); GET /api/download/models/2752735 -r 0-1023 -L -> 307 -> 206 Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/46149344974
probe: full GET /api/download/models/171989 -> 13,649,928 bytes, sha256sum = 8184D4BA9DA2B849638531F3DEF563AD2A0AB695B97FBB74F80AC099F2EB7396 = API hashes.SHA256 (MATCH)
probe: GET /api/download/models/493690 -> 401, 106 bytes, {"error":"Unauthorized","message":"The creator of this asset requires you to be logged in to download it"}
probe: 20-model sample of >35 GiB files -> 12x 206 anonymous, 8x 401 (creator-gated); size is not the gate
probe: paginated /api/v1/models?username=Lykon -> 212 models, 358 files, 452.7 GiB in ONE free account
